summary: Frontend testing completed for multi-language support, referral leaderboard, and PWA push notifications. All core features working correctly except notification settings UI integration.

integration_issues.issue: NotificationSettings component exists but is not integrated into ProfilePage or accessible from any UI element. The component is at /app/frontend/src/components/NotificationSettings.jsx but not exported from components index or used anywhere.

passed_tests: Language selector visible in desktop header (flag icon dropdown with 🇬🇧/🇰🇪/🇫🇷)
Language switching works - English: Home, Discover, Rewards, Coming Soon, Sign In
Language switching works - Swahili: Nyumbani, Gundua, Zawadi, Inakuja Hivi Karibuni, Ingia
Language switching works - French: Accueil, Découvrir, Récompenses, Bientôt Disponible, Connexion
Language preference persists after page refresh (localStorage i18nextLng)
Leaderboard shows prize tiers: #1 Gold Badge + 3-day VIP Trial, #2 Silver Badge + 1-day VIP Trial, #3 Bronze Badge + Early Access
Leaderboard shows Top 10: Rising Star badge
Leaderboard has Weekly/Monthly/All Time tabs - all functional
Leaderboard shows top referrers list with referral counts and badges
Leaderboard translations work - Swahili: Orodha ya Viongozi, Wiki, Mwezi, Wakati Wote, Zawadi
Leaderboard translations work - French: Classement, Semaine, Mois, Tout Temps, Prix
Mobile bottom navigation shows translated labels: EN (Home/Discover/Rewards/Store/Profile), SW (Nyumbani/Gundua/Zawadi/Duka/Wasifu), FR (Accueil/Découvrir/Récompenses/Boutique/Profil)
PushManager and Notification APIs are supported
Notification bell icon visible in header when logged in (with red dot indicator)
User dropdown menu includes Leaderboard link with trophy icon
